description: This file defines the PayGradeAPI class, which provides REST API endpoints for managing PayGrade entities in the OrangeHRM HRM system. It implements CRUD operations including listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting pay grades, utilizing traits, validators, and models specific to PayGrades.

classes.name: PayGradeAPI
classes.description: Defines RESTful API endpoints for managing PayGrade entities, supporting CRUD operations with validation, serialization, and service layer integration.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all pay grades with optional filters, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new pay grade.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a specific pay grade by ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing pay grade.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to delete multiple pay grades by IDs.

methods.name: savePayGrade
methods.description: Helper method to populate and save a PayGrade entity from request data.

methods.name: getCommonBodyValidationRules
methods.description: Defines validation rules for the request body when creating or updating a pay grade.
